verdict.rationale: Numeral ships built-in autonomous background processes (autofile/autoregister, continuous nexus monitoring, automatic alerts, virtual mailbox scanning) and an MCP server that lets AI agents query and act on filings/nexus/registrations, which supports agentic background automation. However, there's no explicit documentation of a user-configurable 'automation builder' or scheduled agent workflows beyond these fixed product behaviors and ad-hoc MCP tool calls. Missing for 10: user-defined automation/trigger configuration UI, evidence of scheduled/recurring agent-initiated tasks, and independent confirmation that MCP-driven actions run unattended in production.
